description: Angular component for a queue form in the Thingsboard UI, managing queue configuration including validation, form state, and interaction logic.

classes.name: QueueFormComponent
classes.description: Angular component implementing a form for configuring queues, with validation, dynamic form controls, and data binding.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers a callback function to propagate changes to the form value.

methods.name: registerOnTouched
methods.description: Placeholder for registering touch callback (not implemented).

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the form group, sets up value change subscriptions, and default form values.

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Enables or disables the form controls based on input.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Populates the form with a given QueueInfo object.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the form, ensuring queue name uniqueness if not a system queue.

methods.name: updateModel
methods.description: Updates the internal model and propagates changes.

methods.name: submitStrategyTypeChanged
methods.description: Adjusts form controls based on the selected submit strategy type.
